options.B: Not later than two months before
options.C: On the exact day it expires
options.D: Not later than six months before

stem: Under Rule 050101, what is one of the two core purposes of Progress Reports on officers on probation?

options.B: To give an officer whose suitability is in doubt timely warning and a reasonable opportunity to correct their faults
options.C: To set the officer's confirmation examination date
options.D: To determine which Ministry the officer will be transferred to next

explanation: Rule 050101: Progress Reports build a full record for judging suitability, and ensure an officer in doubt gets timely warning and a fair chance to improve.

stem: Per Rule 050201, what system did the Performance Management System (PMS) replace for the Federal Public Service?

options.A: The Annual Performance Evaluation Report (APER)
options.B: The Scheme of Service
options.C: The Compulsory Confirmation Examination
options.D: The Certificate of Service

explanation: Rule 050201: the PMS shall replace the Annual Performance Evaluation Report (APER) for the Federal Public Service.

stem: Per Rule 050202, besides measurable output (objectives and targets), what else does the PMS focus on?

options.A: The officer's disciplinary history only
options.B: The officer's state of origin and indigeneship status
options.C: Specified competencies -- the knowledge, skills, and personal attributes needed to deliver job tasks
options.D: The officer's seniority and years of service alone

explanation: Rule 050202(b): PMS focuses on measurable output as well as specified competencies (knowledge, skills, personal attributes) needed to deliver job tasks and meet targets.

stem: Per Rule 050204, what is required of a Reporting Officer relative to the officer being reported on?

options.A: Any officer from a different department, to ensure objectivity
options.B: A member of the Federal Civil Service Commission
options.C: At least five years more service than them, regardless of grade
options.D: At least one substantive grade above them, and their immediate Superior Officer

explanation: Rule 050204: a Reporting Officer must be at least one substantive grade above the officer being reported on, and their immediate Superior Officer.

stem: Per Rule 050205, how must the substance of an adverse comment on an officer's work or conduct be conveyed to them?

options.B: Verbally only, with no written record kept
options.C: Anonymously, without identifying the Reporting Officer
options.D: In writing, in sympathetic terms, aimed at helping them overcome the shortcoming

explanation: Rule 050205: adverse comments must be conveyed in writing, in sympathetic terms, with the objective of enabling the officer to overcome the shortcoming.

stem: Per Rule 050206, who is responsible for furnishing performance reports on an officer who has been seconded to another Ministry/Extra-Ministerial Office?

options.D: The officer's original Permanent Secretary, from before the secondment
